en.headline: Shein shares begin trading on Hong Kong exchange after $1.74 billion IPO
en.dek: The fast-fashion retailer priced 280 million shares at HK$48.56 each, valuing the company at about US$26.5 billion; public offering was 5.63 times subscribed.
body: Shares of Shein Global Holdings began trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on Tuesday after the company raised HK$13.60 billion (about US$1.74 billion) in its initial public offering.

The Singapore-headquartered, China-founded online retailer offered 280 million Class B shares at HK$48.56 each, near the midpoint of its marketed range of HK$47.60 to HK$49.50. The Hong Kong public offering was subscribed 5.63 times and the international tranche 2.59 times, according to a stock-exchange filing.

The listing values Shein at roughly US$26.5 billion, well below the nearly US$100 billion peak private valuation recorded in 2022. Cornerstone investors included existing shareholders such as Boyu Capital, Tiger Global Management and General Atlantic, as well as Tencent and others. Trading opened under stock code 0625.

zh.headline: Shein股份今日於港交所掛牌 集資約174億港元
zh.dek: 快時尚零售商以每股48.56港元發售2.8億股，集資約136億港元，估值約265億美元；公開發售超額認購5.63倍。
body: Shein Global Holdings股份周二起在香港交易所開始買賣，公司透過首次公開招股集資約136億港元（約17.4億美元）。
這家總部位於新加坡、源自中國的網上快時尚零售商，以每股48.56港元發售2.8億股B類股份，接近招股區間47.60至49.50港元的中間位置。根據交易所文件，香港公開發售超額認購5.63倍，國際配售則超額2.59倍。
是次上市將Shein估值約265億美元，遠低於2022年私人市場近千億美元的高峰估值。基石投資者包括現有股東Boyu Capital、Tiger Global Management及General Atlantic，以及騰訊等。股份以代號0625掛牌。
